title.narrative: Climate Smart Education: Supporting Green School Initiative in Nepal

description.narrative:
The objective of this project is to support Nepal to develop climate smart education policies and create model schools and support Government of Nepal to integrate climate agenda in its education sector plan 2022-2031.
The specific objectives of the project are:
-Identify existing policy gaps and develop evidence-based policy tools and frameworks for greening education and climate change in education that are contexualised for the federal, provincial and local levels; -Mmap existing and relevant efforts and interventions by other partners -Map various context-specific (i.e., rural and urban schools) tools for teachers, school management committee and local level government on green schools /greening education -Develop interventions that can pilot ‘green schools’ in selected municipalities and in various contexts such as mountain, hill, Terai including rural and urban settings.
